notes: Biallelic BUB1B - Mosaic Variegated Aneuploidy type 1 (MIM 257300). Allele 1 NM_001211.6:c.2210T>G p.Leu737Ter: nonsense in exon 17/23, NMD predicted, ClinVar Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic (rs759242053), gnomAD 7.9e-05, CADD 36. Allele 2 c.3006T>G p.Asn1002Lys: missense in the kinase domain, absent from gnomAD, CADD 24.5. Presumed in trans (singleton; variants 10,911 bp apart, beyond short-read phasing). Identified by a blind genome-wide pipeline that ranked BUB1B 1st of 140 candidate genes from 5,012,204 variants without encoding the disease or any gene list.
